PLC PROJECT

Bring the bench into Machine Expert – HVAC

Create dedicated writable Status Variables for the simulated values, optional quality flags, and heartbeat. Mirror output commands into separate Status Variables for the bench to read. Use your PLC-local permit and watchdog to select which values your sequence consumes.

For a first closed-loop test, map Fan proof to an input tag, set it to follow a mapped fan run command, and set its on delay to 2 seconds. With the bench active, flip its quality switch if your project handles an invalid feedback signal.
